scope: Persisted player sleep and time-based cat energy recovery

rules.player: 20 stamina and 20 mood per real hour; no extra passive recovery during sleep; active until waking
rules.cat: Starts only after settled in placed bed/cushion; 12/9 seconds, proportional energy up to 20+floor(comfort/20); stop and settle on early wake; cold launch settles old interval without replay

limitations: Only cat energy is recovered by furniture rest in this version.
Physical-device interaction acceptance remains distinct from build/install/process checks.
